query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN enrichmentStatus != 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as not_enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fitScore IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_fit_score,
  SUM(CASE WHEN urgencyScore IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_urgency,
  SUM(CASE WHEN briefData IS NULL OR briefData = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN salesApproachData IS NULL OR salesApproachData = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_sales_approach,
  SUM(CASE WHEN productImages IS NULL OR productImages = '' OR productImages = '[]' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_product_images
FROM companies WHERE searchId = 1500003;
